SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp

DO $$ BEGIN IF current_database() <> 'hmi_mes_demo' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected database'; END IF; IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.alembic_version) <> 1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alembic_version WHERE version_num='0020_line_queue') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected schema revision or database'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='hmi_migrator') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='hmi_app') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dedicated roles required'; END IF; IF (SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='public') IS DISTINCT FROM 'hmi_migrator'::regrole::oid OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid=to_regclass('public.alembic_version') AND relowner='hmi_migrator'::regrole::oid AND relkind='r') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dedicated migrator ownership required'; END IF; END $$

CREATE TABLE item_master (
        id text PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id ~ '^[^[:space:]]{1,128}$'),
        name text NOT NULL CHECK(char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
            AND name ~ '[^[:space:]]'),
        unit text NOT NULL CHECK(char_length(unit) BETWEEN 1 AND 32
            AND unit ~ '[^[:space:]]'),
        enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
        origin text NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('USER','MIGRATION')),
        created_by text REFERENCES users(login) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
        CHECK((origin='USER' AND created_by IS NOT NULL)
            OR (origin='MIGRATION' AND created_by IS NULL))
    )

INSERT INTO item_master
        (id,name,unit,enabled,origin,created_by,created_at)
        SELECT item_id,item_id,'EA',true,'MIGRATION',NULL,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        FROM (SELECT item_id FROM recipe_versions
            UNION SELECT item_id FROM work_orders) AS legacy_items

ALTER TABLE recipe_versions ADD CONSTRAINT fk_recipe_versions_item_master
        FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES item_master(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

ALTER TABLE work_orders ADD CONSTRAINT fk_work_orders_item_master
        FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES item_master(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CREATE TABLE item_audit (
        id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
        item_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES item_master(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        actor text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(login) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        action text NOT NULL CHECK(action='CREATE'),
        occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
        evidence jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(evidence)='object')
    )

CREATE FUNCTION immutable_item_evidence() RETURNS trigger
        LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Item definitions and audit evidence are immutable';
        END $$

CREATE TRIGGER item_master_immutable
            BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON item_master FOR EACH ROW
            EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_item_evidence()

CREATE TRIGGER item_master_no_truncate
            BEFORE TRUNCATE ON item_master FOR EACH STATEMENT
            EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_item_evidence()

CREATE TRIGGER item_audit_immutable
            BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON item_audit FOR EACH ROW
            EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_item_evidence()

CREATE TRIGGER item_audit_no_truncate
            BEFORE TRUNCATE ON item_audit FOR EACH STATEMENT
            EXECUTE FUNCTION immutable_item_evidence()
SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp
UPDATE public.alembic_version SET version_num='0021_item_master' WHERE version_num='0020_line_queue'
